Name: Fish Breeding Tanks
Author: TrentXV
Description:
It adds 6 new machines that are used to breed goldfish, clownfish and koi, it will require fresh water fish food and will produce 5 types fish per week. 
Fish Food Recipe can be bought at Willy.

Recipes for the Tanks can be purchased at Trent's Shop in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4216]Mermaid Island[/url] Summer Market: 

[youtube]nCackNsOFbw[/youtube]


Eventually we are posting the mods separate once we finish creating more new recipes.
The fish used are from our mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish[/url]. Trent did the programming and I, Hisame, did the art.  
The fish bowl end table was donated by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615]EemieStardew[/url]. 

A huge tanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/77289063]Hadi[/url]﻿ for the conversion of the fish tanks!
